text.tspan: A FINITE RESOURCE: MANAGING THE GROWING WATER NEEDS IN THE LAKES REGION | 16
Fig. 2.2. Great Lakes water consumptive use, by category, in 2023
To further explore rising demand for Great Lakes water, this report will focus on three high-consumptive
water-using industries simultaneously poised for dramatic growth over the next decade in the region: data
centers, critical minerals mining, and agriculture.
